component.name: TeXCraft
component.summary: Write LaTeX and see the PDF as you type

description.p: TeXCraft is a LaTeX editor: a project of files, a source editor and the PDF side by side, rebuilt when typing pauses by retex, a TeX engine written in Rust.

ul.li: Project files and the outline, tabs, highlighting, line numbers and error markers
A build log whose messages explain the problem, suggest a fix and open the line
References, bibliographies and indexes settled in one build
SVG, JPEG XL and WebP images without conversion
Recent projects, keyboard shortcuts you can change, light and dark themes
A control channel and an MCP server for agents

screenshot.caption: The build log in the dark theme
